page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a large woodcut initial at the start of the body; no margin notes. Heading block at top (full width), then the column of running text, then signature and page number at the foot.

main_text.head: AD TRES ORDINES BRABANTIAE ANTISTITES NOBILES MAGISTRATVS.
main_text.p: IBELLOS de CRVCE quos scri-psi, meritissimo advos defero, patriae nostrae primores viri. Primum, quia in solo vestro concepti natique sunt, in hac Louanienfi vrbe: tum quia aura fauoris vestri elicuit, qui me benigne huc arcessendum putastis, bono rei litterariae & juuentutis. Laudo hunc animum, atque etiam miror. qui in tot circumstantibus turbis, & cum undique insonuit bello-
Note: the first word "LIBELLOS" is set with a large historiated woodcut initial "L"; it is read here as IBELLOS with the initial letter as printed.

page.notes: The large woodcut initial L (figures on either side) is not transcribed beyond its letter. The first word is printed "LIBELLOS" with the L in the woodcut; the transcription follows the visible letters. Possible doubtful readings: "advos" (advos), "vrbe", "putastis". Word "Antistites" is printed in spaced capitals. The header "AD TRES ORDINES BRABANTIAE" is set in large capitals and may be read as a title.
